Recorded face completeness and independent ancient use remain unresolved.
remedy: Use distinct contributors and dated outputs, preserve 690 prior-file pins, credit inspected sources, independently reconstruct probabilities and allocation tails, retain the prototype counterexample, narrow the administrative result after face-role control, and freeze new-text and context predictions.
